props.name: active
props.description:
Explicit active state. Auto-overridden when `value` matches the parent
island's `value`.

props.name: expand
props.description: Tap toggles the parent island's `open` state.

props.name: icon
props.description: Iconify name shown leading the label (or alone, for icon-only).

props.name: label
props.description: Optional text label. When set, the button morphs to a label-pill.

props.name: mode
props.description:
Mode name — free-form string. Tap switches the parent island's mode to
this. Pair with a `<template #[mode]>` slot on the island defining what
the row becomes. Common pattern names: `'fullisland'` (full takeover),
`'compose'`, `'filter'`, `'reply'`, … any string works.

props.name: reset
props.description: Tap resets the parent island's mode to `'default'`.

props.name: size
props.description:
Sizing override. When omitted, the button inherits the parent
`<VyIsland>`'s `size`. Falls back to `md` standalone.

props.name: value
props.description:
Tab value — registers this button against the parent island's
`v-model:value`. Sets active automatically when the values match.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Override the default label slot (icon stays leading).

slots.name: leading
slots.description: Override the leading icon slot entirely.
